reads.note: Montgomery Road runs along the plate's top edge: south lot line y~133, north edge y~30, about 100 px wide. Clarion (60 ft, house nos. 1800-1834; Montgomery no. 3600 at the corner) comes in from the south between edges ~6247 and ~6335 at y=133, slanting. North of Montgomery is off the plate, so it shows here as a T. A thin diagonal line continues across Montgomery, consistent with Clarion's other leg seen on 22-75. The large 'THE GROWN...' lettering across the lots is a subdivision label, not a street.

Clarion (60 ft, diagonal, lines ~6250/6345 at y 132) runs up to Montgomery Road at the top of the plate (road between y~42 and 132, track ~82). Point on road centre y~87 at Clarion centreline. North side of the road is at the plate's top edge (only a small stub of the next lot), so it reads as a T; road itself fully shown. Only 'ROAD' printed for Montgomery in region (addresses 3600/3614 match).
